top_signals.title: Traders, Economists Boost Bets on Canada Rate Hike Next Week
top_signals.summary: More economists and traders expect the Bank of Canada to hike interest rates next week after the central bank’s latest surveys showed inflation expectations rising.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: How the Buffett Kids Will Shape a $150 Billion Legacy
top_signals.summary: Warren Buffett, chairman emeritus of Berkshire Hathaway, is worth $150 billion, according to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index. Until recently, a longtime favorite of his, Bill Gates, was taking care of giving most of the money away through his behemoth global foundation. Then came the revelations about Gates’ relationship with Jeffrey Epstein. Now, it's Buffett's three children that will inherit the task of distributing his enormous wealth. Bloomberg News' Wealth Reporter Sophie Alexander and US Insurance Reporter Alex Rajbhandari spoke with Susie, Howard, and Peter about their plans for their Dad's legacy. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Anthropic is AI trade's last big hope for a major IPO this year
top_signals.summary: On Kalshi, Anthropic is seen as the last major IPO in 2026 after OpenAI delayed its public market debut. Others have postponed too.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Saudi Arabia to postpone ‘Davos in the desert’ after Houthi attacks
top_signals.summary: Flagship Future Investment Initiative was scheduled to begin next week in Riyadh but will now take place next year
